prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Image 3 is the APPROVED LOOK of this exact boss in its idle pose (pixel art). Keep the identical design, armour, colours, proportions and size; only the pose changes.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: the Drowned Sovereign, exactly as in Image 3: the same tarnished gold crown set with pearls, the aged regal face with pale eyes and wet grey hair, the same impossibly long pearl-white and abyssal-teal ceremonial robes with gold embroidery, their hems pooling wide on the ground, and the coral sceptre; the robes are able to part and open, revealing dark teal tentacles with pale suckers beneath. FACE: the aged human face under the crown, with calm pale eyes, is readable.

Pose: the robes part at the front and three dark teal tentacles with pale suckers lash out far toward the heroes; the crown, face and robe outline stay as in Image 3: the same deep abyssal-teal outer robe with wide sleeves over the pearl-white inner robe, the hems pooling wide on the ground, at the same size as in Image 3, facing right.

MOVEMENT: this is a dramatic ACTION frame of a huge, intimidating boss, not a static stance. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the upper body: lean and twist the torso, extend the arms and anything reaching out of the robe far from the body, and let the sleeves and loose hems flow with the motion while the hem stays on the ground line. The silhouette must be very different from the idle reference. Any part of the body or weapon may reach beyond the sides of the grey box. BODY: a robed figure with no feet showing: the wide robe hem rests on the ground line in every pose and is its ground contact. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a second crown, a throne, a fish tail.
